About the job
Job Details
Job Description:
Join Intel and build a better tomorrow.

Key Responsibilities
Lead development of advanced AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI solutions.
Design and implement scalable data pipelines, analytics frameworks, and AI infrastructure.

Core Competencies
Ability to collaborate effectively within a team setting.
Excellent Communication Skills.

Qualifications
The minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position.

Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in a STEM-related field.
6+ years of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Artificial Intelligence.
Strong programming experience in Python and SQL.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience developing Generative AI applications using RAG and Agentic AI architectures.
Experience developing APIs and microservices.
